title: Using deprecated function in Chainlink
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High - Using stale prices leads to inaccurate calculations of total asset values and share prices.  **Likelihood:** Low - The return price can be wrong or stale without validating  ## Description  To convert from USD to input token amount, `StrategyV5Chainlink` uses `IChainlinkAggregatorV3.latestAnswer`. However the function `latestAnswer` is deprecated by Chainlink.
